<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.115 which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.108 Da. The formula that best matches this mass is C₉H₁₆O (exact monoisotopic mass 140.120 Da, within typical instrument tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C9H16O.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H16O</final_answer>
